name: How long does it take to complete interior finish upgrades?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete interior finish upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior finish upgrades depends on the project's complexity and size. Small projects, like painting a room, might take a few days. Larger renovations, such as a full kitchen or bathroom remodel, could take several weeks to a few months, including planning, material ordering, and installation. Your contractor can provide a timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by complexity. Small jobs take days; larger renovations can take weeks to months. Your contractor will provide a timeline.
